plan: Drive: from Village of Granisle, about 109 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 54.34634, -125.43262, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 50 m S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-6, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
R6J-duck-drive-0001.recDirections: Near Burns Lake, head north on Babine Road for 19.5 km, until you reach the Augier FSR. Turn right onto and follow the Augier for ~10.2 km. Turn Left onto the Grizzly Road and follow for 2 km, then Turn Right onto the Taltapin Road. Follow Taltapin Road for 6.6 km to reach the site.
R6J-duck-drive-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-6: about 875 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.32 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
